title: Mall World Building
content: I have recurring dreams of a city which are not quite mall world (I believe I have been to mall world on a handful of occasions but usually I am in another world) Anyway I got to this building via escalators and I'm sure it was a mall world building (although in the dream it was classified as Pall World lol) Either way, I got to the top of what was an abandoned / converted police building. The top floor was definitely converted into a shopping centre and active with young people. I didn't quite go in, I made my way down the staircase (starting on top floor.) About 4 floors down the building started looking visibly derelict, walls brown with decay, flickering lights, darkness. I remembered that the lower levels of mall world are dangerous (from reading this sub) and I managed to get out of there altogether. Phew. Back to my original dream world. Another dream I had of mallworld there were robots everywhere, and a sense of... danger? Also some LA celebrities, including a giant head of Kylie Jenner (promo material - not human)
